mapper.select: SELECT r.chapter_id, r.word_card_id, r.card_order FROM NC.study_chapter_word_card r INNER JOIN NC.study_chapter chapter ON chapter.id = r.chapter_id INNER JOIN NC.study_part part ON part.id = chapter.part_id WHERE part.dialect = #{dialect} ORDER BY part.part_order, chapter.chapter_order, r.card_order
mapper.delete: DELETE r FROM NC.study_chapter_word_card r INNER JOIN NC.study_chapter chapter ON chapter.id = r.chapter_id INNER JOIN NC.study_part part ON part.id = chapter.part_id WHERE part.dialect = #{dialect}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NC.study_chapter_word_card (chapter_id, word_card_id, card_order) VALUES (#{chapterId}, #{wordCardId}, #{cardOrder})
